card.text: NGC 2392 is a planetary nebula about 1,795 parsecs away.

sources.label: Chornay & Walton (2021), A&A 656, A110; CDS J/A+A/656/A110, Table A.1, PN G197.8+17.3: distance 1,795 pc (1,666 to 1,942) from the Gaia EDR3 parallax of its central star

introduction.text: Hubble's and Webb's pictures of it lie here on the walls its spectra give: a bubble pointed almost at the Sun inside a round shell 0.40 pc across.
